description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary OC-CA. The original dataset (in LMF) comes from http://hdl.handle.net/10230/17107 . The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

other_download.title: Occitan lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the OC lexical entries from the OC-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in OC coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.
